description: The bar chart compares the accuracy of two models, MMAU and MMAR, across two different systems, Audio-Reasoner and Qwen-2.5-Ommi. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, while the horizontal axis lists the two systems. For the Audio-Reasoner system, MMAU has an accuracy of approximately 50%, and MMAR has an accuracy of about 30%. In the Qwen-2.5-Ommi system, MMAU shows an accuracy of roughly 60%, and MMAR has an accuracy close to 50%. The bars are color-coded, with MMAU represented in blue and MMAR in purple. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
